verdict.rationale: Canva documents public Connect APIs for creating and syncing designs, assets, comments, autofill, resize and export, and publishes an OpenAPI description for generating client SDKs. Admin, SCIM and audit-log APIs, an official MCP server and an llms.txt index round out programmatic control. The probe misses on guessed OpenAPI paths only show the spec isn't at a standard well-known location, not that it doesn't exist. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage, an OpenAPI spec at a discoverable standard path, and broad access without plan gating (private integrations require Enterprise; some MCP tools require Pro and above).
